description: Read an Android app file (.apk), given as base64, at most 2,000,000 bytes. Returns the package name, version, minimum, target and compile SDK; permissions grouped by what they reach, each with a plain meaning and whether Android asks the person first; activities, services, receivers and providers with whether each is exported and why; web addresses and hostnames found in the code's string tables, grouped by host; and the signer certificate (subject, issuer, validity, key, SHA-256) from the v1 signature or the v2/v3 signing block, read but never verified. Runs nothing. Pure standard library, no network or model.

file.description: Required. The Android app file (.apk), as base64 or a base64 data URL; at most 2,000,000 bytes once decoded.

filename.description: Optional file name, used only in the result text.

name: inspect_apk
title: APK Inspector
